descFull: Pixel Music is Material 3 Expressive YT music, Free Lossless and local music player for Android. Enjoy a beautiful, free Spotify and YT Premium alternative with local playback, high-res YouTube Music, and Telegram streaming. Loaded with synchronized LRC lyrics, custom 10-band EQ, gapless playback, Wear OS companion, AI playlist helpers.
